answer: One workable design: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because jetty only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. In practice comet is enforced by the ledger itself: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
